llc.formation_notes: Fee set by 31 M.R.S. 1680. Expedited service fees not checked.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: between January 1 and June 1 of each year, starting the year after formation
annual_report.late_penalty: $50 in addition to the filing fee

sources.title: 31 M.R.S. 1680 Filing and copying fees; penalties
sources.quote: For filing of a certificate of formation under section 1531, a fee of $175

sources.title: 31 M.R.S. 1680
sources.quote: For filing of an annual report under section 1665, a fee of $85 for a limited liability company ... Late filing penalty ... a fee of $50

sources.title: 31 M.R.S. 1665 Annual report
sources.quote: annual reports must be delivered to the office of the Secretary of State between January 1st and June 1st of the following calendar year.

personal_exemption.notes: $5,300 per taxpayer (and spouse if MFJ). HOH standard deduction $23,550; HOH brackets 5.8% < $41,100, 6.75% < $97,300, 7.15% above. Standard deduction and exemption phase out at higher incomes (not detailed here).

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: New for 2026: 2% surcharge on Maine taxable income above $1,000,000 single / $750,000 MFS / $1,500,000 MFJ and HOH (the 0.0915 bracket above = 7.15% + 2%). Thresholds indexed from 2027.

sources.title: Maine Revenue Services, 2026 Individual Income Tax Rates (revised May 20, 2026)
sources.quote: $64,850 or more (1) $4,117 plus 7.15% of excess over $64,850

sources.title: 2026 rate schedule, Note (1)
sources.quote: the tax calculated above is increased by a surcharge of 2% on the portion of the taxpayer's Maine taxable income greater than $1,000,000 if filing single

sources.title: 2026 rate schedule
sources.quote: Personal Exemption: $5,300 ... Standard Deduction: Single - $15,700 Married Filing Jointly - $31,400

estimated_tax.required_if: estimated Maine tax after withholding and credits is $1,000 or more and prior-year tax liability was also $1,000 or more

unemployment_2026.notes: New employer rate 2.23% UI + 0.14% CSSF + 0.17% UPAF = 2.54% combined. Wage base $12,000 from 26 M.R.S. 1043.

notable: New 2% income tax surcharge from 2026 on taxable income above $1M single / $1.5M joint, making the top rate 9.15% (https://www.maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/2026-05/ind_tax_rate_sched_2026_rev.pdf)
Top 7.15% bracket starts at $64,850 single, low for a freelancer (https://www.maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/2026-05/ind_tax_rate_sched_2026_rev.pdf)
LLC: $175 to form, $85 annual report due by June 1, $50 late penalty (https://legislature.maine.gov/statutes/31/title31sec1680.html)
No pass-through entity elective tax and no local income taxes.
uncertain: The first 2026 rate schedule (Sept 2025) was revised on 2026-05-20 to add the surcharge; third-party sources still cite $15,300 standard deduction from older versions. Values here are from the revised MRS sheet.
Absence of a Maine PTET was not confirmed on an official page.
Phase-outs of the standard deduction and personal exemption at higher incomes not recorded.
